content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm having an issue with a [product_name]. This equipment was functioning fine, but five days ago I updated the program by adding another analog sensor to the existing module and included a data log that records the analog values from both sensors every 30 seconds. After a day with the new setup, the program started to restart itself – entering stop mode and resuming run mode about every 1 hour and 40 minutes, as the video shows. I’ll also share the program file, but note that the comments are in Portuguese, my native language.
Which [product_name] model are you using exactly? Please provide the full order number and firmware version.
The order number is: [article_no]. I'm unsure how to find the firmware version.

Hi, as a first step, check if the power supply is functioning correctly. If it is, try using a different [product_name] to see if the same issue occurs. I've experienced a similar problem with another [product_name] in my test setup before.

analysis.insight_summary: Users describe that after updating a [product_name] to add an additional analog sensor and enable regular data logging, the device started to unexpectedly reboot approximately every 1 hour and 40 minutes. This behavior affects system reliability and continuous operation after program changes. Other users recommend hardware checks – such as verifying the power supply and testing with a different module – suggesting uncertainty about whether the cause is hardware or software related.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to operate reliably after making program changes, such as integrating more sensors and new logging features, and wish to avoid unexpected restarts or stop mode events.
